user.title: Configure Energy Manager
user.description: Create one Energy Manager entry and select all EcoFlow battery SOC sensors. Then pair each battery with its charge switch and PowerStream controls.

data_description.grid_power_sensor: Current grid import (+) / export (−) in watts. Usually from your smart meter or energy monitor.
data_description.solar_power_sensor: Current solar production in watts from your PowerStream or inverter.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Select one or more battery state of charge sensors (percent), one for each EcoFlow battery to manage.
data_description.discharge_switch: Shelly relay that controls AC output from the PowerStream. Turned on/off to start/stop feed-in.
data_description.ev_charger_switch: Switch entity that starts/stops the EV charger. Leave empty to disable EV surplus charging.
data_description.ev_charger_current_number: Number entity to control the EV charging current (amps). Leave empty to disable EV surplus charging.

error.no_battery_selected: Select at least one battery SOC sensor.

reconfigure.title: Configure Energy Manager Batteries
reconfigure.description: Choose the batteries to manage, then select a charge switch and PowerStream controls for each one. Existing limits are kept for batteries that remain selected.

error.no_battery_selected: Select at least one battery SOC sensor.

battery_pairing.title: Battery controls: {battery}
battery_pairing.description: Select the charge switch and PowerStream controls for {battery}.

reconfigure_pairing.title: Battery controls: {battery}
reconfigure_pairing.description: Confirm the charge switch and PowerStream controls connected to {battery}.

init.title: Energy Manager
init.description: Choose which part of Energy Manager you want to configure.

data_description.battery_capacity_wh: Battery capacity used with SOC to balance feed-in between batteries.

data.ev_min_battery_soc: Min Battery SOC for EV Charging

data_description.ev_charger_switch: Switch entity that starts/stops the EV charger. Leave empty to disable EV charging.
data_description.ev_charger_current_number: Number entity to control the charging current (amps). Leave empty to disable EV charging.
data_description.ev_min_battery_soc: Battery must reach this SOC before EV surplus charging starts (100% = fully charged first).
data_description.ev_min_excess_power: Minimum excess solar power (watts) before EV charging starts.
data_description.ev_min_charging_current: Minimum charging current in amps (usually 6A per EV standard).
data_description.ev_charger_phases: Number of phases used by the EV charger.

data_description.feed_in_mode: Dynamic adjusts feed-in to match consumption. Static uses a fixed value.
data_description.feed_in_static_power: Fixed feed-in power when using static mode.
data_description.min_battery_soc: Stop discharging when battery reaches this SOC.
data_description.max_grid_feed_in_power: Maximum power to feed into the home.
data_description.grid_power_tolerance_discharge: Acceptable grid import while discharging. Higher = less grid import but less battery usage.
data_description.max_grid_import_solar_charge: Maximum grid import allowed during solar charging (0 = pure solar only).
data_description.min_charge_power: Minimum battery charging power (below this, charging is stopped).
data_description.update_interval: How often the manager evaluates and adjusts (seconds).
data_description.deadband: Power deviation threshold before adjusting (prevents oscillation).
data_description.feed_in_deadband: Grid power range around the target where feed-in is held steady.
data_description.charge_power_step: Step size for charge power adjustments per cycle (hardware constraint).
data_description.feed_in_power_step: Step size for feed-in power adjustments per cycle.
data_description.min_dwell_time: Minimum time to stay in a state before transitioning (seconds).
